content: This document provides a summary of information about a specific product but does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare provider. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as kidney or liver function tests, may be required while using this medication to monitor your health. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in August 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. Always seek advice from your healthcare provider for complete and personalized information about this product and your health needs. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most current information, contact the applicable plan provider.
